$comment: Generated from repository.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to repository.yaml>`. Do not edit.

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (ADR-0015). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

RepositoryCandidate.description: One repository. It is named only in grounded_on; its name, PID systems, access and upload conditions, certificates and metadata standards are in the cited evidence items' content (ADR-0015). The judgements here are read from those records or compared with the needs.

assigns_pids.description: Whether the registry lists a persistent identifier system the repository uses. re3data does not say whether assignment is automatic.

commercial.description: Whether an institution responsible for the repository is listed as commercial.

fee_required.description: Whether the registry lists a fee as a condition of depositing data.

meets.description: The needs this repository meets, as recorded by its registry entries.

misses.description: The needs this repository does not meet, or that its records leave open. Flagged for the researcher; never resolved by the agent.

notes.description: Facts the researcher should weigh that are neither met nor missed needs: fees, a commercial platform, the deposit conditions FAIRsharing's curators record.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

RepositoryCandidate.title: RepositoryCandidate

SearchedSummary.description: What was looked for, so a reader can judge an abstention as well as a recommendation.

snapshot_ref.description: Which copies of the registries answered, e.g. re3data:snapshot:2026-10-29.

SearchedSummary.title: SearchedSummary

description: The repository advisor payload. Repositories recommended or described, each grounded on its registry records. The researcher selects; the agent does not.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

not_found.description: Mandated repositories for which no registry record was found.
